questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Det betød meget for mig, at vælge en engelsksproget destination, hvilket har været en stor fordel både fagligt såvel som socialt.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Universitet var generelt super gode til at kommunikere vigtige deadlines, hjemmesider og information. Dertil tildeles de studerende en vejleder, som man kan række ud til, og som har meget kort svartid.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Min vejleder sendte alle deadlines og lokationer for introduktionsugen.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: USYD stiller boliggaranti for ét af deres kollegier, Queen Mary Building.

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: Der var et stort delt køkken.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Det er et super godt sted at socialisere og meget populært blandt danske studerende. Der er hyppig rengøring af fællesfaciliteterne, men det bliver hurtigt beskidt, når man er 7-800 personer, der deler.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Det foregår ved, at man søger godkendelse direkte gennem sin vejleder, hvorefter man tilføjer fagene på universitets hjemmeside. Der er to uger "add and drop"-periode fra semesteret starter, hvor man frit kan udskifte fag. Derudover vælger man timeslot for øvelseshold online, hvor der generelt er fire forskellige tidsrum at vælge imellem. Der er stor fleksibilitet, og generelt var underviserne meget imødekommende og ekstra forstående over for udvekslingsstuderende.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Vejlederen er til rådighed til spørgsmål over mail, og man kan også booke en tid til et fysisk møde.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik alle de kurser, som jeg ønskede.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Vælg dine kurser (hvis muligt) efter interesse! Vær hurtig på tasterne, når der åbnes op for tilmelding af øvelseshold. Det lykkedes mig at klumpe min undervisning sammen, hvilket gjorde at jeg kun skulle møde fysisk op én dag om ugen i de sidste to måneder af opholdet.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Generelt var niveauet nemmere end på KU.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Det mindede mere om gymnasieundervisning, hvor der var mødepligt til øvelseshold - som iøvrigt også var mere interaktive, og de forventede en faglig diskussion, hvor alle deltog.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Anthropology of Gender and Sexuality
Anthropology in the World
Sport and Learning in Australian Culture
Outdoor Education Education

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Jeg vil anbefale at vælge et "udvekslingsfag" såsom Sport and Learning in Australian Culture
eller Outdoor Education Education, hvor der er en lav arbejdsbyrde i forhold til andre fag. Derudover, så vælg fag ud fra egeninteresse. Der er en god håndfuld første- og andensårs fag, der ikke kræver kurser inden for feltet. Eksempelvis havde jeg et andetsårs antropologifag som sociologistuderende uden problemer.

Food DKK per month *
Personal spending DKK per month *

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Ingen uventede omkostninger.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Generelt minder prisniveauet meget om Danmarks. At spise ude og transport er billigere, men at handle ind selv og alkohol er dyrere.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Der er utrolig mange foreninger, som er frit tilgængelige for de studerende at deltage i.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Oplev Australien og de omkringliggende lande! Engager dig i det lokale miljø, eksempelvis brugte jeg meget tid med medstuderende fra queermiljøet,

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Tag på forlængede ture rundt i landet og brug eventuelt ferierne på udlandsrejse. Semesteret slutter allerede i november, så der er også rig mulighed for at rejse efterfølgende.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Utrolig nemt, idet at den australske kultur minder meget om den danske.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Vær åbensindet og grib de muligheder som bliver stillet til rådighed fra USYD og de sociale udvalg. Interager med lokale i din undervisning.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Jeg oplevede ingen i forhold til Australien som land eller dets indbyggere, men nok mest i forhold til andre medstuderende. Jeg har ikke haft dårlige oplevelser i forbindelse med disse forskelle, de har nærmere indbudt til dialog.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Den mere "laid-back" atmosfære samt diversiteten, både blandt det australske folk, men også i udvekslingsmiljøet.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Brug tid i dit lokalmiljø og nyd din nye hverdag. Sæt tid af til at opleve andre byer end Sydney og andre lande end Australien. Mærk efter og brug den korte tid du har med mennesker, som du får noget positivt ud af at være sammen med.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Nej.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: At få lov til at falde ind i nye hverdagsrutiner så langt hjemmefra, og at lære mig selv at kende i nye relationer med folk, der på ingen måde har det samme udgangspunkt som mig selv.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: At ikke skulle gå på kompromis med mig selv særligt i sociale sammenhænge og relationer.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
